desc: Denim pioneer dating back to 1873 with a selection of jeans, casualwear, jackets & accessories.
addr: Lower Ground Floor, Brigade Road, Shop No 25, First Floor, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Excellent store and great collection. Clothes are super comfy and great in quality. I specially want to mention about Munna and Catherine. Munna did everything possible to make us happy. Great store, amazing staff. Thank you Munna.

Had a great shopping experience at Levi's. Catherine was extremely helpful and patient throughout the visit. She assisted me in choosing clothes that fit well and suited my style, offering useful suggestions without being pushy. Excellent customer service and a pleasant shopping experience overall. Highly recommended!

They really have great customer service. The associates Catherine and Munna who helped us at the store knew exactly which fit and size worked best. In and out with a great new pair of jeans in no time.
